info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Case Management API
info.description: The Card Case Management API enables consumers to effectively manage card cases within the banking system. This endpoint facilitates the deletion of specific card cases, identified by a unique parameter. Typical users include customer service representatives and banking operations teams who need to maintain accurate records and workflows regarding card-related issues. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their card servicing processes and minimize operational clutter.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a card case identified by its unique ID. Ensure that you have the appropriate permissions before attempting to delete the case, as this action is irreversible.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific card case identified by CARD-400045. Ensure that you provide any required fields as specified in the schema.

DeleteCardCase400045Request.description: A request body for deleting a card case operation. This should contain the details required to perform the delete operation.
